description: A flat padded board on which leaves of gold are laid out, breathed flat, and cut to size. It is dusted with a little powdered abrasive so the gold cuts cleanly and must stay grease-free.
name: gold cushion

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter XIV, p.199. Internet Archive.
